description: This script reads an input file, optionally reads a PID from a file or a string, computes the SHA-256 hash of the input, and writes the PID/pid bytes, hash, and input data to an output file. It appears to be used for processing payload data with associated identifiers, likely in a communication or firmware context.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input and optional PID file or hex string, computes SHA-256 hash of input, and writes PID bytes, hash, and input to output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and invokes create_output to process files accordingly.
